info.title: OpenSPP API
info.description:
The externally reachable API surface of an OpenSPP deployment. OpenSPP is a social-protection registry and programme-management platform built on Odoo, and it exposes two very different things.

1. **OpenSPP's REST API v2** (`spp_api_v2` and its extension addons, FastAPI, base path `/api/v2/spp`) — OAuth 2.0 client-credentials, consent-respecting resource endpoints that address records by external identifier (`system|value`) and never expose Odoo database ids. Since @openfn/language-openspp 4.0.0 this is the only API the adaptor calls: its `request()` and every named operation go to `/api/v2/spp/*`. The 107 operations here are every route the API V2 app registers, taken from the vendor source (OpenSPP/OpenSPP2 @ a71e8f04, branch 19.0): Individual, Group (members, merge, split, membership history), advanced `_search`/`_filters`, `$batch`, `$bulk/export`, Consent, ChangeRequest, Program, ProgramMembership, Cycle, Entitlement, Product/ProductCategory/UnitOfMeasure, ServicePoint, Vocabulary, Data push/pull, GIS (OGC API Features, geofences, spatial queries, GeoPackage export), simulation and aggregation, and Studio fields/variables. Which of these a deployment serves depends on the addons it installs; each deployment also serves its own generated schema at `/api/v2/spp/openapi.json`.

2. **Odoo's external API** — RPC, not REST. `POST /xmlrpc/2/common` and `POST /xmlrpc/2/object` speak XML-RPC (Content-Type text/xml); `POST /web/session/authenticate` and `POST /jsonrpc` are the JSON equivalents. @openfn/language-openspp up to 3.x routed all twenty of its operations through `execute_kw` here (via odoo-await) against the OpenSPP Odoo models (res.partner, g2p.group.membership, g2p.program, g2p.program_membership, spp.service.point, spp.area). Because Odoo dispatches model methods by name at runtime, that surface is two endpoints wide and open-ended in depth.

Base URL is per deployment.

get.description: `spp_api_v2` is built on FastAPI and generates an OpenAPI document reflecting the modules installed on this instance.

default.description: Error.

post.description: Exchange API-client credentials for a JWT bearer token (client_credentials grant). The handler reads the credentials from an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body, an HTTP Basic Authorization header (RFC 6749 section 2.3.1), or a JSON body; the OpenFn adaptor sends JSON. Rate limited per client IP.

get.description:

get.summary: Get all groups an individual belongs to (reverse lookup)
get.description:
Returns a Bundle of group memberships with the following information:
- Group reference (Group/{system}|{value})
- Individual reference (Individual/{system}|{value})
- Membership role (head, spouse, child, etc.)
- Start and end dates
- Membership status (active/inactive)

- status: Filter by "active" or "inactive" (default: all)
- _count: Maximum results (default: 100)

Security:
- Requires scope: individual:read
- Applies consent filtering if applicable

post.description: Odoo's unauthenticated `common` service. The openspp adaptor's `login` step calls `authenticate(db, login, password, {})` here through the odoo-await client and keeps the returned integer uid for every later call. Body and response are XML-RPC documents.

schema.description: XML-RPC `methodCall` document (Content-Type: text/xml). OpenAPI cannot describe XML-RPC method dispatch, so the body is carried as the raw XML document.

200.description: XML-RPC `methodResponse` document — either a `params` value or a `fault`.

post.description: Odoo's `object` service. Every openspp adaptor operation funnels through `execute_kw(db, uid, password, model, method, args, kwargs)` here: `search_read`, `search`, `create` and `write` against the models res.partner, g2p.group.membership, g2p.group.membership.kind, g2p.program, g2p.program_membership, spp.service.point and spp.area. The callable method set is open-ended — Odoo dispatches by name at runtime — so this single operation is the whole XML-RPC surface.

schema.description: XML-RPC `methodCall` document (Content-Type: text/xml). OpenAPI cannot describe XML-RPC method dispatch, so the body is carried as the raw XML document.

200.description: XML-RPC `methodResponse` document — either a `params` value or a `fault`.

post.description: JSON equivalent of the XML-RPC `authenticate` call. Same semantics, JSON bodies. Documented because the same OpenSPP/Odoo instance serves it; the adaptor itself uses the XML-RPC endpoint above.
